memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in activities of daily living; works as a bank clerk full‑time.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports low mood linked to poor sleep.
carers: Mother; relationship mother.
goals: "I want to sleep better and reduce back pain so I can work comfortably."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
melatonin 3 mg HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0)
Haemoglobin 13.2 g/dL (12‑16)
Insomnia Severity Index score 18 (0‑28, higher worse)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: positive at 40° on the right, suggesting lumbar radiculopathy.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had worsening lower‑back pain radiating to the right buttock over the past week, making it hard to sit at work.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-06-10 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent; occasional difficulty sitting >2 h due to back pain.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait slightly antalgic on right; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Mood improved with better sleep; occasional irritability from pain.
carers: Mother; relationship mother.
goals: "I want to sit through my workday without pain and get restful sleep."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
pregabalin increased to 150 mg BD
 diclofenac continued 50 mg BD after food
 melatonin 3 mg HS
 trazodone 50 mg HS
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.0 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0)
Haemoglobin 13.0 g/dL (12‑16)
Insomnia Severity Index score 12 (0‑28)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Lumbar spine MRI shows L4‑L5 disc bulge causing right‑sided foraminal narrowing; no cord compression.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Orthopaedic Spine Service, Bengaluru General Hospital, for evaluation of L4‑L5 disc bulge and radiculopathy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Orthopaedic opinion: conservative management advised; continue pregabalin, consider short course of oral steroids if pain worsens; physiotherapy referral.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages work with occasional lumbar support brace; reports improved sleep.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, pregabalin 150 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Mood stable; denies depression.
carers: Mother; relationship mother.
goals: "I want to keep working full‑time without needing sick leave for back pain."

falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds.

mood: Mood good; enjoys social activities.
carers: Mother; relationship mother.
goals: "I want to maintain my current health and prevent any worsening of back pain."
